description: Wasmtime versions 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contain a denial of service vulnerability. This flaw allows malicious WebAssembly modules to cause the host to panic due to improper handling of the may_leave flag during memory reallocation (realloc). Attackers can exploit this by invoking host calls during realloc operations, leading to crashes.
